Leigh Clk This Indenture, made the Eighteenth day of March in the year of Our Lord One thousand Eight hundred and twenty six Between Iram Hyde & Mary his wife of the town of Jackson in the County of Washington & State of New York of the first part, and Robert McNeil & James McNaughton of the town of Cambridge County & State aforesaid of the second part, Witnesseth, That the said parties of the first part, as well for the better securing to the parties of the second part, the faithfull payment of the Debt which they justly owe to the parties of the second part, in manner hereafter mentioned, as in consideration of the sum of One Dollar, to them in hand paid by the parties of the second part, the receipt whereof is hereby acknowledged, Have granted, bargained, sold, aliened, released and confirmed, and by these presents, Doth grant, bargain, sell, alien, release and con firm unto the said parties of the second part, and to their heirs and assigns for ever, All that piece or parcel of land situate lying & being in the town of Jackson County & State aforesaid and is bounded on the North by lands owned by Sylvester Warner on the East by lands owned by James Woodall & James Woodall Jr, on the South by John Robertson & on the west by John Robertson which land that is meant to be mortgaged is all our right & title to the lot of Land which was owned by William Robertson ( now deceased ) and to which we are entitled to an equal part with the other heirs of the said William Robertson deceased which Land a part has been set off and divided between the heirs and also another equal proportion which is undivided 487 the whole containing near Twenty acres of land be the same more or less . Together with all and singular the edifices, Buil dings, Rights, members, Hereditaments and appurtenances to the same belonging, or in any wise appertaining and all the estate, right, title, interest, property, claim and Demand whatsoever of the said parties of the first part, of, in, or to the same, and the reversion and reversions, remainder and remainders thereof, To have and To hold the said premises hereby granted and released, with the rights, members, hereditaments, and appur = = tenances thereunto belonging, and every part and parcel thereof, unto the said parties of the second part, their heirs and assigns, to the only proper use and behoof of the said parties of the second part, their heirs and assigns for ever . Upon condition Nevertheless, That if the said Iram Hyde and Mary his wife of the first part, their heirs, executors, administrators or assigns, shall faithfully pay to the said parties of the second part, their Executors, administrators or assigns the just & full sum of Seventy three dollars twenty five cents with interest from date interest & principal to be paid in one year from date according to the tenor and true intent and meaning of a certain bond bearing date herewith and duly made and executed by Iram Hyde of the first part, to the said parties of the second part, then this present indenture, and the Estate hereby granted, and every article and clause herein contained, as well as the said bond shall cease and become utterly void . And it is hereby mutually coven anted and agreed between the parties to these presents, that if default shall be made in the payment of the principal secured to be paid to the said parties and the interest which shall accrue thereupon at any time or times on which they shall be due, or of any part of such principal or interest, that then and from thenceforth it shall be lawful for the parties of the second part their heirs, Executors, administrators or assigns to grant, bargain, sell, and dispose of the said hereby granted premises, and all benefit and equity of redemption, of the said parties of the first part, their heirs, executors, administrators or assigns therein, at public auction in fee simple, giving notice of such sale according to the directions of the act of the Legislature, in that case made and provided . Item I give and bequeath unto my Nephew William Lyde Younger son of my deceased Brother the Sume of one thousand pounds of like mony of England to be paid unto him by my Executor hereafter named within one year next after my decease And if any of my said Nephew or Negres shall dye or depart before the moneys and lay them by this my will shalbed hereby payable or portion of him or them so dying shall redound to my & Executor hereafter named, All my Messuage Lands Conemon State Jewell goods Leases Pattell Shattles and the rest and residue of my ready mony whatsoever not before bequeathed my debts being first paid my funerall Expences, and Legaciesdischarged  I give and bequeath unto my loving Cephew Humph Hyde Second some of my aforesaid late loving Brother Bernard Hyde deceased, whom I make sole Executor of this my last will and Testament, and to the Heirs and Assignes of the said Humphrey, for ever . Provided always and so as thatmy  said Executor do justly, duly, and truely satisfy and say all and every the Legacies before hereby given and bequeathed according to the intent and true meaning of this my last - Will and Testament And doe hereby charge my said Executor that he doe duly and justly pay and deliver all --- such Legacio or Legacies as shall at any time hereafter write down with my own hand either under this my Will or on the East side of the same to such person or persons as shall will and appoint the same to be paid and delivered And Lastly I doe hereby renounce revoake and disannull all former wills by me made and do declare this to be my last Will and Testament, In witness whereof I havehereunto  sett my hand and seal the day and year first above written : John Hyde published and declares to be the last will and Testament in the pence of Jo : Pressy : Tho : Tomlyn and Thomas Duckendershore  following Legacies I bequeath whose names and hereunder written if they shall survive me, To my Nephew M. Hyde of Langhoff and to his wife to such of them five pounds apeice to all my children forty shillings and to the poore of S Simstons in the East London five pounds to the poore of Sundrige and in or five pounds five pounds To my friends John Dorsey Ellen Rogers my Mayde Servant Ten pounds to all my other Servants that shalled with me at my death wenty shillings a dice Probatum fuit himsmodi - Testament in vicesime die mensis July Anno Domini Millesime Sereno Septnagesimo - Male timo roam vonorabili vio Domino Richards Loyd Doctore Surroto ventie wire domini Roberts - Lyman Militis Decanal de Shore Legum Sam Lortoris Deran five County   Stwist Dan Jr am of Croydon Eli Dathis of Metropone  rigintonis mediate time constitute Iram   Humphred Hyde Armigers Executors in in demnominal  in on a fine Administratio omnium of sington 1 Conorum Jurim I strate & day ad Ridditorum to do the bene at field - St Do Evangeliarite Jurch Concord am ords fee Collacone per Nos the Tellott No .
